observation_summary: Element-wise operations on sparse vectors return 0.0 instead of NaN when encountering 0.0 multiplied by Infinity or 0.0 divided by 0.0.
reasoning_summary: The implementation of ebeMultiply and ebeDivide in OpenMapRealVector iterates only over the non-zero entries of the current vector. It assumes that if an entry is zero in the current vector, the result of the operation (multiplication or division) will remain zero regardless of the corresponding entry in the operand vector. This assumption fails for special floating-point values like NaN or Infinity, where 0.0 * Infinity should be NaN, not 0.0. The code fails to account for these cases because it skips the indices where the current vector has zero entries.
